resources.string: Inspect local technical events and choose what to share

Diagnostics stay on this device until you save or share them. Operational events exclude health values, health record IDs, requested health dates, paths, endpoints, and credentials. They are not anonymous.
Verbosity changes detail—not permission to collect health content. Retention: up to 7 days / 20 MiB. No automatic uploads.
V1 private context records peer names where available. It does not capture health payloads, credentials, or arbitrary error text. Private segments expire within 24 hours on the next app access.
Delete local events, prepared bundles, and attachment copies? This stops private recording. Exported files and shared copies are unaffected.
Showing the newest 100 matching events. The bundle includes the selected snapshot, up to 10,000 events; any truncation is disclosed.

Add any existing files, including health exports or screenshots. Original bytes are copied unchanged and are NOT scrubbed. Source filenames are included. No new health reads are made. Limit: 50 files / 100 MiB.
Frozen snapshot: %1$d events. Health content: %2$s. ZIP is not encrypted.
I Reviewed the Files I Want to Share

The ZIP is not encrypted. Included private context and attachments may expose health data or secrets. Public GitHub/Discord posts may be accessible to anyone. The destination controls its own copies; Health.md cannot recall them.
Local bundles expire within 24 hours on the next app access, and only the newest 3 are retained. Saved or shared copies have their own retention.
